meta.description: Registry for operator reduction and symbolic rewrite failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: non_terminating_reduction
failure_modes.description: The reduction sequence fails to reach a normal form within a finite number of steps.

failure_modes.name: reduction_loop
failure_modes.description: Rewrite rules create a cyclic dependency where the same symbolic state is repeatedly revisited.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_overcollapse
failure_modes.description: Reduction results in the loss of critical process information required for reconstruction or stability.

failure_modes.name: branch_reduction_instability
failure_modes.description: Reduction of multi-valued branches leads to erratic or inconsistent output sets.

failure_modes.name: projection_aliasing_reduction
failure_modes.description: Simplification of projected structures erases markers required for preimage identification.

failure_modes.name: transport_reduction_divergence
failure_modes.description: Simplification of transport paths leads to states mapping outside all declared admissibility windows.

failure_modes.name: residue_reduction_drift
failure_modes.description: Reduction logic results in unintended divergence or drift in the residue state.

failure_modes.name: non_unique_normal_form
failure_modes.description: Different reduction paths lead to distinct, non-equivalent symbolic states.

failure_modes.name: undefined_intermediate_symbolic_state
failure_modes.description: Reduction produces a symbolic form that has no formal class or rule registration.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_loss_under_reduction
failure_modes.description: Reduction results in a state that violates the core admissibility constraints of the target law.
